apps.name: Fluxa
apps.subtitle: Your media, in one place.
apps.versionDescription:
## What's Changed

- fix(skin): show the focused link label at full strength (`3f670fd1`)
- fix(ui): let unstyled labels inherit the text color of the element they sit in (`0615118d`)
- fix(skin): keep the bottom menu sheet sized by viewport width (`a14c2686`)
- fix(skin): keep the live guide now-line sized by viewport height (`6a689247`)
- fix(skin): keep the nav dock sized by viewport units (`682ad38d`)
- feat(ui): resolve top-level percent sizes against the viewport (`8f888e36`)
- feat(ui): accept calc, min, max and clamp in width and height with parent-relative percents (`315c1d61`)
- feat(ui): add one calc, min, max and clamp evaluator for lengths (`b2889272`)
- feat(host): log skipped and built skin frames in the frame stats (`3ac27807`)
- feat(ui): replay an unchanged skin frame behind FLUXA_FRAME_SKIP (`bdb3b83c`)

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/FluxaMedia/fluxa/compare/v0.3.11...v0.3.12
